architecture:
## Android architecture — Producer (Studio) area

### 0. Engine decision (OPEN → decided for this area): Oboe/AAudio + small C++ DSP core, Kotlin owns all logic

**Decision:** one NDK module `android/app/src/main/cpp/studiodsp/` (CMake, C++17) exposing a thin JNI surface; **all scheduling, state, persistence and musical math stay in Kotlin.** Rationale, grounded in the iOS history:
1. The iOS arranger was forced OFF per-node graphs onto ONE `AVAudioSourceNode` render callback that sums clips and runs `TrackFXKernel`/`MasterFXKernel` in-block (MultitrackPlayer.swift; custom AUv3 failed on device). The Android analogue of "one render callback" is an **Oboe output stream with a data callback**; Java `AudioTrack.write` loops add 20–40 ms jitter and GC pauses and cannot host a SoundFont synth with playable latency.
2. Instruments need a SoundFont renderer. There is no platform SF2 synth on Android. **TinySoundFont** (single header, MIT) renders GeneralUser GS presets; `tsf_load_filename` + `tsf_set_output(TSF_STEREO_INTERLEAVED, 44100)`; one preset loaded per staff (the iOS "loadSoundBankInstrument loads ONE preset" fact holds).
3. Tempo/pitch (sample rate 0.5–10×, pitch ±12, span stretch, strip bake, Beat Match warp) needs a time-stretcher. **Signalsmith Stretch** (MIT, header-only) is used OFFLINE only (pre-bake, as iOS does) — never in the realtime callback.
4. Everything deterministic is pure Kotlin and JVM-tested (step timing, loop windows, BeatMath, trimGap, quantizer, SMF, score layout, chord/drum/melody detectors, biquad/Freeverb coefficient math). The C++ side is small: PCM mixer, TSF wrapper, stretch wrapper, and float-array ports of TrackFXKernel/MasterFXKernel (also callable offline from Kotlin via JNI for WYSIWYG bounce ≡ live).

Fallback if NDK is blocked: `StudioOutput` is an interface; a Kotlin `AudioTrack` implementation exists for the emulator/CI path (latency irrelevant there) and is the default on the emulator; Oboe is the device default. Both consume the same `RenderGraph` pull API.

**Codecs:** decode via `MediaExtractor`+`MediaCodec` → canonical **44.1 kHz stereo Float32** (`StudioAudio.canonical`), resampled on import (iOS `convertToCanonical`). Encode AAC `.m4a` via `MediaCodec`+`MediaMuxer`; loops write **`.wav` LPCM** with an authoritative `frames` count (CAF has no Android writer; same seam-tick rationale). `AVURLAsset.hasProtectedContent` ⇒ reject DRM imports = `MediaExtractor.getDrmInitData() != null` or decode failure.

### 1. Packages (`com.levi.pocketdj.`)
- `studio.model` — `StudioModels.kt` (@Serializable mirrors of every iOS struct, same JSON keys), `StudioFactory` (id minting, `studioPrefixes`, `isStudioId`), `StudioSource` custom serializer (`type` discriminator exactly as StudioModels.swift:54-107).
- `studio.store` — `StudioStore` (single doc `pocketdj-studio.json` under filesDir, versioned writer on `Dispatchers.IO`, `scheduleSave` debounce + `flush()`, `StateFlow<StudioDocument>`; cues mirror `pocketdj-studio-cues.json`), `StudioFolders` (families, filename shapes, SAF roots), `StudioReconcile`.
- `studio.audio` — `StudioAudio` (canonical format, gain math, `trimmedOrPadded`), `PcmBuffer` (FloatArray + frames), `AudioDecoder`, `AacEncoder`, `WavWriter`, `StudioRender` (offline: renderSample/renderLoop/bouncePattern/carveTrackRegion/carveStemMix/importAudioFile/stretch/transform/renderTake/mixPCM, FX-tail drain to −60 dBFS or 3 s, priming head trim), `StudioOutput` (Oboe/AudioTrack), `RenderGraph` (what the callback pulls), `LocalAudioCache` (download rip/cut/stem mp3 → `studio-src/` with atomic rename; the "burn rung").
- `studio.dsp` — pure Kotlin kernels mirroring TrackFX.swift/MasterFX.swift (biquads, Freeverb-lite, delay, chorus, phaser, ring-mod, drive, Brazilian bass) with identical parameter structs; used by offline render; the C++ copies are generated from the same constants and cross-checked by a golden test.
- `studio.engine` — `StudioEngine` (sample audition chain, slice one-shot, loop audition, pattern scheduler with `StudioPatternClock`, `stepFrames/stepTime/loopWindow/mappedStep`, rolling `armSlot` horizon, choke, live step mirror), `InstrumentEngine` (TSF voice, `InstrumentEventLog` lock-protected, take/live/overdub logs, click, arp scheduler, replay), `MicRecorder`, `MultitrackPlayer` (clip list → render callback with per-track gain/pan/FX + master FX, loop/seek frame cursor, `playGeneration`, natural-end nonce), `ArrangerBouncer`, `ArrangerClipBaker`, `ArrangerBeatMatch`, `AudioFocusPolicy` (mic-capture-active flag + AudioFocus request; every playback start consults it).
- `studio.midi` — `MidiInput` (android.media.midi, USB + BLE via `MidiManager.openBluetoothDevice`), `SmfWriter`, `SmfParser`, `MidiImport`.
- `studio.score` — `ScoreQuantizer`, `ScoreLayout`, `ScorePlayhead`, `ScorePdf` (PdfDocument), `Accidental`.
- `studio.packs` — `InstrumentPackStore` (index fetch offline-first via CatalogService pattern, OkHttp streaming download to temp + sha256 + atomic move, grouped by bankKey).
- `studio.demux` — `DemuxModels`, `DemuxStore` (`demux-cache/<key>.json`, audio/, stems/<key>/), `ChordDetector`, `DrumPatternDetector`, `MelodyTracker`, `DemuxInstrumental`, `KeyDetector`, `BeatDetect`, `BeatMath`, `StemClient` (manifest stems keys, `/stemify`, `/stemify-custom`, poll).
- `screens.producer` — `ProducerScreen` (sub-tab row persisted in AppSettingsStore `studioTab`), `samples/`, `loops/`, `sequencer/`, `instruments/`, `cues/`, `demux/`, `tracks/`, shared `MixerDeck`, `WaveformView`, `EditSlider`.

### 2. Data flow / threading
- UI (Compose) ← `StateFlow` from stores/engines; engines are `@MainThread` facades (mirror of `@MainActor @Observable`) whose realtime state lives in lock-free structs read by the audio callback.
- **Realtime thread rule (load-bearing, from InstrumentEngine):** MIDI receive (`MidiReceiver.onSend`, runs on a MidiManager thread) calls `nativeNoteOn` directly and appends to `InstrumentEventLog` under a `ReentrantLock`-free `AtomicReference` ring; UI highlights drain at 30 Hz; staff publish at ~10 Hz; never per-note main-thread posts.
- Offline renders run on `Dispatchers.Default` inside a `StudioRender` single-permit `Mutex` (iOS actor). Decoding never on main.
- Store writes: snapshot → IO thread → temp file → `rename` (version monotonic; later version wins).
- Audio ownership: one audible owner at a time — `PlaybackController` (Media3) vs Studio engines. Starting a Studio engine calls `playbackController.pause()` and requests `AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN`; focus loss pauses engines (iOS interruption park); `AudioDeviceCallback`/Oboe `onErrorAfterClose` → rebuild stream and re-prime active players (zombie-node lesson).
- Mic: `MicRecorder` sets `AudioFocusPolicy.micCaptureActive`; `PlaybackController` and all Studio play paths refuse to change audio mode/route while it is set.

### 3. Platform APIs
Oboe (prefab AAR `com.google.oboe:oboe`), NDK/CMake, `MediaExtractor/MediaCodec/MediaMuxer`, `AudioRecord` (or Oboe input), `android.media.midi`, `PdfDocument`, SAF `ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE`/`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT` (import audio/MIDI), `FileProvider` share sheet (export PDF/MIDI/audio), `WorkManager` only for pack download retries (foreground download otherwise), Compose `Canvas` for waveforms/score/timeline, `LazyRow` with per-second anchors for follow-scroll.

### 4. Persistence shapes (shared with iOS)
`pocketdj-studio.json` identical keys (StudioDocument); `demux-cache/<key>.json` identical (DemuxDocument); instrument index `rips/instruments/index.json` identical; beatgrid sidecar `rips/analysis/<id>.json` `{beatGridBpm, firstDownbeatMs, steady, beatsMs, downbeatsMs}`; lyrics sidecar `rips/lyrics/<id>.json`. `RipManifestEntry` gains additive optional fields (`firstDownbeatMs, beatGridBpm, steady, beatgrid, stems{vocals,drums,bass,other}, stemVersion, lyrics`). Loop file extension `.wav` is the one documented divergence.

### 5. Tiers
- **Tier 0 (core, P0):** models/store/folders, audio core + native lib, Producer shell, Samples (mic/import/from-track via LocalAudioCache), Loops, Sequencer, Cues, Collections playback of studio ids, Storage rows.
- **Tier 1 (P1):** Instruments (packs, synth, keys, takes, score, exports), MIDI (USB/BLE), Arp + overdub, Tracks arranger (model+UI, player, bounce/record/trim/beat-match), Demuxer core (chords, timeline, stems) .
- **Tier 2 (P2):** Demux drum/melody/instrumental/cut-sample/lyrics, mixer deck everywhere, slices, folders polish.

### 6. Shared touch points (named once, every package lists which it touches)
`MainActivity.kt` (Producer composable + routes), `di/AppGraph.kt` (new singletons), `AndroidManifest.xml` (RECORD_AUDIO, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT/SCAN, FileProvider), `app/build.gradle.kts` + `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (NDK/CMake, Oboe, media3-common), `data/storage/StorageService.kt` (studio categories), `playback/PlaybackController.kt` (local-file studio playback branch), `data/rips/RipsModels.kt` (additive fields), `data/settings/AppSettingsStore.kt` (studioTab, click toggles, folder URIs).
decisions: Mix/Studio DSP engine for this area: Oboe/AAudio output stream + small C++ core (TinySoundFont for SF2, Signalsmith Stretch for OFFLINE time/pitch, ported TrackFX/MasterFX kernels); all logic/state/math in Kotlin; AudioTrack implementation of the same StudioOutput interface for the emulator. Justification: iOS converged on a single render-callback manual mixer; Android has no platform SF2 synth; Java AudioTrack cannot carry playable instrument latency.

Studio document JSON stays key-compatible with iOS pocketdj-studio.json (schemaVersion 1, additive-optional fields only, per-element lossy decode, pattern rows normalized to max(raw.count,16)); loops are .wav (LPCM) instead of .caf — documented divergence, device-local doc so no sync impact.

The 'burn' rung of the sample/demux source ladder becomes LocalAudioCache (download public rip/cut/stem mp3 to app cache, atomic rename); no general Burn/offline store is built in this area — if the Collections/Playback area ships a BurnStore, LocalAudioCache delegates to it.

Studio ids are played on Android by a local-file branch in PlaybackController (ExoPlayer file:// MediaItem) resolved through StudioStore.localUrlForPlayback — never sent to /rip (PlayResolver STUDIO_LOCAL_ID already fences it).
On-device speech transcription is N/A on Android (SpeechRecognizer is mic-only); Demux lyrics display the cloud sidecar only — equal to iOS default behaviour (gate off).
USB and BLE MIDI both go through android.media.midi.MidiManager (no custom GATT parser); device-only verification.
Stem playback primitive (synced 4-stem player) is a cross-area dependency on the Mix engine package; DMX-1 ships a single-file fallback and a StemPlayer interface the Mix area implements.
Realtime callback never allocates, locks, or touches Kotlin objects shared with UI except via atomics/pre-filled float arrays; MIDI → synth direct on the MIDI thread; UI drains at 30 Hz.
Every engine play()/stop() exit logs a distinct reason tag (StudioDiag) — the iOS 'no sound vs never called' lesson.

Packages are sized for one Sonnet implementer; shared files (MainActivity, AppGraph, Manifest, gradle, StorageService, PlaybackController, RipsModels, AppSettingsStore) are touched only where each package says so, and STU-1/STU-2 land first so later packages mostly add new files.
